description:
With the Aleph MCP Server, you can:
- Plug into a governed source of truth for clean, structured cross-system data from 200+ integrations:ERP, CRM, HRIS, spreadsheets, data warehouse, and more
- Ask questions in plain language, build reports, and run analyses, with every output traceable back to your source of truth
- Power automations across Slack, Linear, and your other tools
